morning.headline: Futures Rise on Tech Strength, Semiconductor Rally
morning.summary: US index futures show a risk-on tone, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 up 0.48% and 0.88% respectively. Overnight, Asian markets surged, led by South Korean and Japanese tech stocks, with SK Hynix jumping 15.91%. The VIX fell 4.65% to 18.04, and the 10Y yield is down 1.4bp to 4.54%. Both SPY and QQQ are in net long gamma territory, suggesting dealers may dampen volatility.

highlights.label: Tech Rally
highlights.text: South Korean and Japanese tech stocks, including SK Hynix (+15.91%) and Samsung Electronics (+8.97%), led overnight gains, driving a risk-on sentiment.

highlights.label: Gamma Support
highlights.text: SPY and QQQ are positioned in net long gamma, with spot prices above their respective gamma flips, indicating dealers may buffer price swings.

highlights.label: Model Picks
highlights.text: The model's top picks include SNOW calls and JPM calls, with NKE puts being a previous pick ahead of CPI data.

highlights.label: Macro Levels
highlights.text: The 10Y yield is trading lower at 4.54%, the dollar DXY is down 0.33% to 99.72, and the VIX has decreased 4.65% to 18.04.
